content: Cornell ConvoKit's official Supreme Court Oral Arguments Corpus docs confirm advocate side codes: 0=respondent, 1=petitioner, 2=amicus curiae (does not track which side amicus supported), 3=unknown. Matches the SideEnum mapping already assumed in 29-CONTEXT.md canonical_refs (verified via direct data scan during discuss-phase). Speaker types are justice/advocate/unknown; corpus spans 1955-2019.
